meta.name: battleofthefour
meta.author: Tozike
meta.description:
Welcome to Battle of the Four!

This mod tries to create a battle simulation with mindustry units.
Changes Serpulo's mech, support mech, air and crawler type units and the three cores to fit better in this style.
Many units got new weapons, new abilites and changed stats. Burning and shocked effects are also changed for even better damage.
All these units are stronger than the default units and they are made for this mode specificly and not for normal campain, but you can do whatever you please.
Also includes a map called: BOTF 1 to play on.
That's it have fun!
